name: waypage-share
description: Waypage's native pieces as a local Capacitor plugin (the same shape as LifeLog's native/widgets). No JavaScript: the app calls them as Capacitor.Plugins.<name>. Android and iOS: ShareTarget, PageRender, Print, FileSave, Files, Speech, Downloads, SignIn, Brightness, Feeds, Widgets, Translate, AppLock, Kokoro and Audiobook; iOS also Connection. Android only: VolumeKeys, Pen, Drive, Look and Car.
